description: Effectifs disponibles SNCF depuis 1851 is a dataset listed in SNCF Open Data, an open data portal of a railway operator, published or maintained by SNCF. Effectifs dis ponibles en moyenne annuelle du Groupe Public Ferroviaire SNCF (hors filiales) depuis 1851. Précisions: Le nombre d'« agents disponibles » correspond au nombre d’agents en équivalent temps plein mis à disposition de l’entité pour le mois considéré. Coverage: France. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Informations institutionnelles et financières. Its keywords are effectifs, ressources humaines. The portal shows 2017-01-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Database License (ODbL) (https://data.sncf.com/pages/licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sncf-open-data-portal.
